# ADR-3107: A09: Documented reduced logging mode for privacy region 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Privacy regimes constrain security logs.

## Decision

Products MAY adopt a documented reduced logging mode for privacy region 11 (A09-11) when local law restricts telemetry.

## Consequences

Compensating monitoring is described.
